notes: Track capacities are nominal architecture resources, not available resources after fixed-design reservations.
Without a device-topology query, half_column_limit=12 preserves the legacy AMF/ISPD placement budget; it is not a measured XCU250 hardware capacity.

With a complete target-device topology query, the SLICE half-column limit is derived from actual clock-leaf connectivity instead of the legacy 12 budget. Endpoint sampling does not prove general simultaneous clock routability.
The rectangular clock coverage budget is a placement model; it does not prove detailed clock routability.
The initial supported die is XCU250. Other parts, including Spartan UltraScale+ with nonuniform vertical tracks, require explicit rules and validation.
